description: Return the MySQL database provisioned for a specific instance (by id or exact name): hostname, port, database name, username, a phpMyAdmin link, and (only when `confirm` is true) the password. Reports `exists: false` when the server has no database yet. Also tells the user which plugins or tools are configured for it.

confirm.description: Set true to include the password in plaintext. Only do this when the user explicitly asked to see it.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name: get_database_info
title: Get Database Info
